hypothesis: A failed revisit of a recent low followed by a confirmed close above the intervening high may precede sustained buying. This is unproven; no historical occurrences or returns for this detector have been scanned.
definition: See PROTOCOL.md; consecutive strict 2-left/2-right confirmed lows, frozen ATR14 at first-pivot confirmation, similar lows and intervening rebound, prior-drop requirement, then buffered neckline close crossing. New confirmed pivots supersede pending pairs; gaps reset; expiry and low-price invalidation cancel. Early breakouts are rejected; availability is actual breakout close, never the pivot time.
baseline: All completed 1h decisions with finite positive prior-bar ATR14 and at least 16 completed candles in the current segment. No pattern filter. Identical 5m execution and 24h hold; complete paths required and split-crossing labels purged.
feasibility_scope: After registration review, scan causal pattern events only. Report counts, yearly frequency, timing boundary exclusions, 24h-plus-5m scheduled occupancy with 60m cooldown, and active 28-day blocks. Use the earliest eligible baseline decision in each pool floored to UTC day as block origin. No outcomes at feasibility.
multiplicity: Registration and feature feasibility add no return test. If outcomes are later evaluated, append exactly M5R6/confirmed_double_bottom_1h as test 37 to the pinned 36-test ledger. Preserve prior IDs/p-values and recalculate BY; no other primary hypothesis.
adaptive_disclosure: All eight prior candidates and their failures were seen. This is adaptive exploratory research, not fresh confirmation. Parameters were chosen as a single interpretable definition without historical tuning; they are not asserted to be optimal or standard.
stopping_rule: Stop after registration and synthetic tests for review. Later feature-only feasibility must pass all unchanged gates before an outcome proposal. Failure stops the candidate without loosening thresholds. No automatic historical scan, alternate parameter set, additional hold, or new round.
